title: Suhba Seasons Potluck
desc:
Bismillah. 

“Then do they not reflect upon the Qur'an, or are there locks upon their hearts?” (Surah Muhammad 47:24)

A new season awaits us, a new chapter in store. Join in suhba as we reflect on the summer season, potluck style.

We look forward to seeing you there inshAllah.
